source.description:
The database rows come from: `type` selects the source adapter, the
rest of the table is that adapter's options.

stream.description:
The stream between the source side and the sinks: `type` selects the
adapter, the rest is its options. Omitted means the in-process channel
with its defaults.

prefix.description:
Literal prefix prepended to every index name flusso owns (indexes,
aliases, and the flusso_meta index), so several deployments can share
one OpenSearch cluster without colliding: `dev_` gives `dev_users`.
Include any separator yourself. `--index-prefix` / `FLUSSO_INDEX_PREFIX`
override it at run time (flag > env > file). The flusso-query consumer
must apply the same prefix. Empty (the default) means no prefix.

on_error.description:
What to do when a sink rejects a document at the item level (a mapping
conflict, a malformed value): stop the run, or skip the document and
continue. Each `[[index]]` may override it.

server.description:
Bind addresses for the operational HTTP surfaces. The `FLUSSO_*`
variables and CLI flags override these (flag > env > file).

sinks.description:
Named sink destinations. Each key is the sink name; `type` selects the
adapter, `backfill` is the one universal key, and the rest of the table
is the adapter's options. With no sinks, `run` uses a stdout sink.

index.description: One entry per index to build.

title: flusso Config
description: One flusso deployment: one source, one stream, its sinks, and the indexes to build.

SchemaPath.description: Path to the index schema YAML file, resolved relative to the config file's directory.

oneOf.description:
Stop the run on the first rejected document. The batch is left
unconfirmed and redelivered on restart, so a persistently-bad document
halts sync until the data is fixed or the policy is changed. The default,
because dropping data should be opt-in.

Quarantine each rejected document (surfaced via metrics/status and logs)
and continue: the rest of the batch is applied, the slot advances, and
the poison is not redelivered — it simply never lands until its source
row changes again.

FailurePolicy.description:
What the pipeline does when a sink **rejects a document at the item level** —
it accepted the batch but refused a specific document (a mapping conflict, a
malformed value). Distinct from a flush-wide failure, which always stops the
run. Set globally on the config and overridable per index (both live in the
`config` crate's `Config`/`Index`, which assemble this policy).

Server.description:
Bind addresses for the two operational HTTP surfaces, from a `flusso.toml`
`[server]` table. Both are optional — the binary layers `FLUSSO_*` env vars
and CLI flags on top (which win), falling back to built-in defaults when all
are absent. Each is a `host:port` socket address, parsed and validated at
config-read time by [`SocketAddr`]'s own deserializer.

type.description: The adapter that implements this port.

backfill.description:
Whether this sink is ever backfilled. `false` makes it receive live
changes only, never a snapshot: the opt-out for a stateless sink beside a
stateful one, which would otherwise be re-seeded on every restart.

SinkEntry.description:
One `[sinks.<name>]` table: the adapter's port entry plus the universal
sink keys every sink engine honors regardless of adapter.

name.description:
The index's logical name; the OpenSearch alias and the `flusso-query`
binding use it.

schema.description: Path to the index's `*.schema.yml`, relative to the config file.

enabled.description:
Whether this run builds and follows the index. A disabled index keeps
its entry but is neither seeded nor updated.

on_error.description:
Per-index override of the global [`on_error`](crate::toml::ConfigToml::on_error)
policy. Omitted inherits the global default.

IndexEntry.description: One `[[index]]` entry: an index to build from a schema file.

IndexName.description: An index name: lowercase letters, digits, and underscores, not starting with a digit, at most 63 characters.

source_postgres_Connection.description: A connection URL (literal or `{ env = "VAR" }`), or a table of connection parts.

Secret.description: A literal value, or `{ env = "VAR" }` to read it from the environment at run time.

password.description: The role's password, literal or `{ env = "VAR" }`.

source_postgres_Parts.description:
The parts table, used only to deserialize the `Parts` arm so serde's field
defaults and unknown-field rejection apply without re-deriving them by hand.

oneOf.description: Use TLS if the server offers it, without verifying anything.
Require TLS, without verifying the certificate.
Require TLS and verify the certificate against the CA bundle.
Require TLS, verify the certificate, and check the hostname.

source_postgres_SslMode.description: `sslmode` for the source connection, in libpq's terms.

connection_url.description:
How the database is reached: a URL, literal or `{ env = "VAR" }`, or a
table of parts (`host`, `port`, `user`, `password`, `database`).

manage_publication.description:
Whether flusso may create or extend the publication to cover every table
the indexes read, when the source role is privileged enough. `false`
makes flusso only report coverage gaps and never issue publication DDL.

slot.description: The logical replication slot flusso consumes. Created on first run.

ssl_root_cert.description:
PEM file of trusted CA certificates for the `verify-*` modes. Overrides
the URL's `sslrootcert`.

ssl_cert.description:
Client certificate chain PEM for mutual TLS; pairs with `ssl_key`.
Overrides the URL's `sslcert`.

ssl_key.description:
Client private key PEM for mutual TLS; pairs with `ssl_cert`. Overrides
the URL's `sslkey`.

ssl_sni_hostname.description:
SNI hostname sent in the TLS handshake when it differs from the
connection host (IP connections, load balancers).

capacity.description:
Changes buffered between capture and processing before capture waits.
A bounded buffer is what makes the slowest sink pace ingest.

oneOf.description:
Built-in OpenSearch components only: works on any cluster with no
plugins. Accent and case folding via `asciifolding` + `lowercase`.

The `analysis-icu` plugin (`icu_tokenizer` / `icu_folding` /
`icu_normalizer`) for stronger multilingual handling. Requires the plugin
on every node, or index creation fails.

sink_opensearch_TextAnalysis.description: Which analyzer toolkit the sink wires its `flusso_*` analyzers onto.

url.description: Base URL of the cluster, literal or `{ env = "VAR" }`.

tls_verify.description:
Verify TLS certificates. Set `false` for a local cluster with a
self-signed certificate.

max_bytes.description:
Maximum serialized size of one bulk request, in bytes. A flush is split
so no request exceeds this, independent of `batch_size`, keeping
requests under OpenSearch's `http.max_content_length` (100 MB by
default). A single document larger than this is sent on its own.

max_retries.description: Retries for a transient failure of a whole request.

pipeline.description: An ingest pipeline applied to every indexed document.

number_of_shards.description: Primary shards for each index flusso creates.

number_of_replicas.description: Replica shards for each index flusso creates.

refresh_interval.description:
The `refresh_interval` applied to each index once its backfill completes:
the steady-state visibility ceiling (`"10s"`, `"1s"`, or `"-1"` to
disable automatic refresh). Indexes are seeded with refresh off and
handed this value afterwards; a flush that catches the pipeline up
forces an immediate refresh, so this only bounds staleness while a
backlog drains.

text_analysis.description: Which analysis toolkit the built-in `flusso_*` analyzers use.

auto_subfields.description:
Whether `text`/`keyword` fields are enriched with a good analyzer and the
`keyword` / `keyword_lowercase` / `text` subfields. A field's explicit
mapping always wins.

pretty.description:
Pretty-print each envelope over several lines instead of one compact
JSON line per operation.
